Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.intro: {units, plural, =0 {No vehicles yet} one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} in {models, plural, one {# make & model} other {# makes & models}}.
Fleet.empty: Nothing here yet. Start with “New Product”, then add your vehicles to the inventory, or import them all from a CSV file.

import.title: Import vehicles from CSV
import.intro: One row per vehicle. The whole file is checked first: if any row has a problem, nothing is saved.
import.columnsHelp: “make” and “model” are required. If they match the Moto Mangos list below, the vehicle goes on that entry; where a model has several generations, “model_year” picks the right one. If they don't match, the vehicle goes on a make & model of your own, which is created if you don't have it yet: give “vehicle_type” (motorbike, car, atv, boat or other; blank means motorbike) and “category” (the choices are under Categories below; required for a motorbike or a car; for several, separate them with a semicolon, like “adventure; touring”). A motorbike also needs “cc” and “transmission” (automatic, semi_auto or manual); for other vehicles both are optional. “name” is optional: your own name for the make & model. Leave “plate” blank for a vehicle without one yet. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; odometer is in {unit}; purchase price is in {currency}.
import.done: Imported {units, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} and {models, plural, =0 {no new models} one {# new model} other {# new models}}.
import.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} found. Nothing was imported.

motoMangos.title: Moto Mangos
